purpose.en: Build core strength to resist arching.

text.zh: 双掌固定，双脚同时向后滑远再收回
text.en: Keep your hands planted and slide both feet back, then return

text.zh: 肘和膝接近伸直，胸廓和骨盆一起动
text.en: Keep elbows and knees nearly straight and move your ribs and pelvis together.

text.zh: 只滑到能控制的距离，不塌腰
text.en: Slide only as far as you can control without sagging.

commonErrors.en: Sliding too far and losing control.

cautions.zh: 需要先能无痛做直臂支撑；先做 1 组 4 次
cautions.en: You should already hold a pain-free straight-arm plank; start with one set of 4 reps.

cautions.zh: 手腕、肩或腰疼痛就停止
cautions.en: Stop if your wrists, shoulders, or lower back hurt.
